verified_facts.text: The hotel is on the corner of West 28th Street and Broadway.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is located on the corner of West 28th Street and Broadway.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was conceived as a pillar of the city's historic floral district, and its decor and design draw inspiration from nature.
verified_facts.excerpt: Conceived as a pillar of the city’s historic floral district, the hotel’s exceptionally detailed decor and design draw inspiration from the beauty of nature.

verified_facts.text: Zaytinya, the hotel's all-day restaurant, serves mezze inspired by Turkish, Greek and Lebanese cuisines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover Mediterranean dining at Zaytinya, our all-day NoMad hotel restaurant in New York, featuring innovative mezze inspired by Turkish, Greek and Lebanese cuisines.

verified_facts.text: Bazaar Meat is a steakhouse by chef José Andrés where wood-fired cooking is at the heart of the menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Begin a voyage through fire and flavor at Bazaar Meat, where wood-fired cooking is at the heart of it.

verified_facts.text: Nubeluz is a rooftop cocktail bar by José Andrés, designed by Martin Brudzinski.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nubeluz is a rooftop bar in New York City, designed by Martin Brudzinski.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club lounge is on the 36th floor of the building.
verified_facts.excerpt: located on the 36th Floor of the building

verified_facts.text: Club lounge access requires an upgraded booking of a Club Level guestroom or suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking of a Club Level guestroom or suite.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa is a subterranean space with separate relaxation lounges, saunas and steam rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: a subterranean escape with eight treatment rooms including a couple’s suite, separate relaxation lounges, experience showers, saunas, and steam rooms.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers facials and massages by Augustinus Bader, Dr. Dennis Gross and ESPA.
verified_facts.excerpt: exclusive facials and massages by Augustinus Bader, Dr. Dennis Gross, and ESPA

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are finished in terrazzo marble and stocked with Diptyque amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover terrazzo marble bathrooms and Diptyque amenities in our Manhattan-view accommodation.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have oversized windows with views of New York City.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our NoMad hotel in New York features rooms with oversized windows offering views of New York City.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has two bedrooms, a dining area, a media room and a private wellness space.
verified_facts.excerpt: this refined Manhattan retreat features two bedrooms, a dining area for entertaining, a media room, and a private wellness space.

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse Residences have full kitchens and access to The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Penthouse Residences featuring unforgettable Manhattan views, full kitchens, dining areas fit for entertaining, and access to The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment and Peloton bikes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fitness center on C2 with Technogym, Peloton & more.

verified_facts.text: Children staying as Ritz Kids get a special check-in experience, custom amenities and itineraries from the concierge team.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids enjoy a special check-in experience, custom amenities, and bespoke itineraries created by our concierge team.

verified_facts.text: The Tour de José is a private guided evening through Zaytinya, Bazaar Bar, Bazaar Meat and Nubeluz.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Tour de José is a private guided evening through four incredible restaurants and bars.

verified_facts.text: Reservations are required for Nubeluz and The Bazaar by José Andrés.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reservations are required for Nubeluz and The Bazaar by José Andrés.

verified_facts.text: Nearby attractions include Madison Square Park, the Flatiron Building, the Empire State Building, Bryant Park, Hudson Yards and the High Line.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nearby iconic attractions include Madison Square Park, the Flatiron Building, the Empire State Building, Bryant Park, Hudson Yards and the Highline.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler's review says each room has a stand-alone soaking tub and steam shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each room has a stand-alone soaking tub and steam shower.

verified_facts.text: Nubeluz serves a weekend High Tea with a caviar selection and Champagne bottle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: From sweet to savory, you can begin your experience with truffled grilled cheese, a caviar selection, and Champagne bottle service.
